name: Written Response to Student Complaint
description: At each level of the student complaint process the complaint is considered and a written response is issued.
preparedBy: Building administrator, Assistant Superintendent/central office administrator, Superintendent, or Board (at each level)
deadline: generally within fifteen (15) business days at each level
quote: At each level, the complaint shall be considered, and a written response shall be forthcoming, generally within fifteen (15) business days, unless the student(s) is/are advised that a longer period of time is needed in order to appropriately respond.
